title: URLSession request target uses plaintext HTTP in swift — review required
description: A request built from an http:// URL sends its path, query and body in clear text. App Transport Security normally blocks this, so the code either also disables ATS or targets a host with an exception. The rule flags the literal scheme; whether the host is internal is a review decision.
remediation: Use https:// for every request and remove ATS exceptions that exist only to allow this host.
limitation: Lexical: matches a literal http URL in a URLSession request; a scheme held in configuration is out of scope.
